<thought>To determine the number of aromatic carbon atoms, I will first obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample using the `carbon_nmr_spectra` tool. Then I will retrieve typical carbon chemical shift ranges with `retrieve_carbon_shifts` to identify which peaks correspond to aromatic carbons (generally ~110–160 ppm). By counting the peaks that fall within the aromatic range, I can provide the integer count of aromatic carbon atoms.</thought>
<action>carbon_nmr_spectra</action>
